children: Ashok Leyland is accelerating its electric commercial vehicle ambitions with a contract to deploy over 200 electric trucks for cement distribution, while simultaneously developing new light commercial vehicle (LCV) platforms to expand its addressable market coverage to 80-85 per cent from 55-60 per cent as it seeks to capitalise on rising commercial vehicle demand and electrification.

Speaking during the company’s Q2 FY27 earnings call, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer Shenu Agarwal said its electric mobility-as-a-service subsidiary OHM Mobility has secured a major freight transportation mandate.

title: Ashok Leyland expands EV push with order of 200 trucks for cement transport, eyes wider LCV market
